summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its September 21, 2026 Membership Interests Purchase and Sale Agreement, through subsidiary SRC Envy Holdco LLC, to acquire all membership interests of Envy Development DE, LLC and Envy Recreational, LLC, owners of Envy Pompano Beach real estate. The $90.0 million purchase price, subject to adjustments, comprises refinanced property debt of $44,557,435.93, 14,263,025 common shares at a contractual $3.00 per share ($42,789,075), and a $2.0 million unsecured promissory note. Closing occurred September 23, 2026, with 7,000,000 shares escrowed. Watch share overhang and release schedule.
